Added: MA-PHARMACY-INSPECTION-COSTS-AND-CORRECTION-PLANS (247 CMR 9.24(2), 9.25) and MA-NONRESIDENT-DRUG-STORE-PHARMACY-LICENCE (s. 39J, 247 CMR 6.02(4), 6.09); MA-NONRESIDENT-COMPOUNDING-PHARMACY-LICENCES is cited as taught in SG-MA-PRACTICE-STANDARDS. 247 CMR 13.00 carries two differently numbered versions of its later paragraphs in the official PDF, so the section cites those paragraphs without numbers. The section teaches as inference or arguable, with safe courses: an expired permit treated as no permit (no grace period in the texts), the expiry of a provisional outsourcing registration issued late in an odd year, the reach of the non-resident licence (drug preparations versus controlled substances), and the start of the 21-day plan of correction. Fee amounts are not taught.
